data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate commenced operations in 2018 and received a portfolio transfer at 1 January giving opening gross claims outstanding of 163.213m (USD). At 31 December 2018 gross claims outstanding were 221.625m (USD) (an increase in the year of 60.065m gross), but the report does not present a distinct gross prior-year (pre-2018) reserve movement amount or a reconciliation labelled 'movement in prior years' separate from current year movements. Consequently a quantified prior-year development (release or strengthening) cannot be determined from the disclosed notes.
raw_causal_phrases: The provision for claims outstanding comprises the estimated cost of settling all claims incurred but unpaid at the balance sheet date, whether reported or not.
Because there was no reinsurance programme in place for the 2018 YOA, this accounting policy was not implemented.
data.data_quality_notes: Amounts are reported in the statements' native currency (USD). This Syndicate began operations in 2018 and received a portfolio transfer at 1 January (163,213 $'000). The report does not present a discrete 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross figure separated from current year movements nor a PY breakdown by underwriting-year older than 2018, so a standalone gross prior-year development amount cannot be calculated from the available disclosures. The 'Change in claims outstanding' number (60,065 $'000 gross) is for movement during the year in total and mixes components; per the extraction rules, no gross prior-year-only figure is derivable, hence prior_year_development_gbp_m is null.
